description.zh-CN: 管理 Cloudflare 账户、Workers 和云服务。
description.en: Manage Cloudflare accounts, Workers and cloud services.

description.zh-CN: 管理任务、项目、文档和工时。
description.en: Manage tasks, projects, documents and time tracking.

note.zh-CN: 调用额度取决于 ClickUp 工作区套餐。
note.en: Usage limits depend on your ClickUp workspace plan.

description.zh-CN: 管理项目看板与业务流程。
description.en: Manage project boards and business workflows.

note.zh-CN: 首次连接通常需要账户管理员批准；批准后请重新登录授权。
note.en: An account admin usually needs to approve the first connection. Sign in again after approval.

description.zh-CN: 整理个人与团队待办、项目和任务。
description.en: Organize personal and team tasks and projects.

description.zh-CN: 连接白板、流程图与协作内容。
description.en: Work with whiteboards, diagrams and collaborative content.

note.zh-CN: 团队或组织管理员可能需要先开启 MCP。
note.en: Your team or organization admin may need to enable MCP.

description.zh-CN: 查询和更新表格数据库与业务记录。
description.en: Query and update bases and business records.

note.zh-CN: 如果组织限制第三方集成，需要管理员放行此连接。
note.en: If your organization restricts third-party integrations, an admin must allow this connection.

description.zh-CN: 管理网站、CMS 内容和设计操作。
description.en: Manage websites, CMS content and design operations.

note.zh-CN: 操作设计画布时，还需要在 Webflow 中打开官方 Bridge App。
note.en: Design canvas operations also require the official Bridge App to be open in Webflow.

description.zh-CN: 检索会议笔记、摘要和讨论记录。
description.en: Search meeting notes, summaries and discussions.

note.zh-CN: 可访问的数据范围取决于套餐；企业管理员可能需要开启 MCP。
note.en: Available data depends on your plan. Enterprise admins may need to enable MCP.

description.zh-CN: 管理客户、联系人和销售跟进。
description.en: Manage customers, contacts and sales follow-ups.

description.zh-CN: 检索客服对话和客户资料。
description.en: Search support conversations and customer records.

note.zh-CN: 目前仅支持数据托管在美国的工作区。
note.en: Currently available only for US-hosted workspaces.

description.zh-CN: 管理 Postgres 项目、数据库分支和 SQL。
description.en: Manage Postgres projects, database branches and SQL.

description.zh-CN: 查询错误、分析问题并辅助排障。
description.en: Investigate errors, analyze issues and troubleshoot.

description.zh-CN: 管理网站部署、项目与团队资源。
description.en: Manage site deployments, projects and team resources.

description.zh-CN: 分析产品事件、用户行为与实验。
description.en: Analyze product events, user behavior and experiments.

description.zh-CN: 分析产品指标和用户行为。
description.en: Analyze product metrics and user behavior.

note.zh-CN: 欧盟数据区请在连接地址中选择 mcp.eu.amplitude.com。
note.en: For EU data, select the mcp.eu.amplitude.com endpoint.

description.zh-CN: 诊断 Plaid 银行连接，查看转化率和产品用量。
description.en: Diagnose Plaid connections and review Link conversion and product usage.

note.zh-CN: 需要团队至少有一个 Plaid 产品获批 Production 权限；仅支持生产数据。
note.en: Requires Production approval for at least one Plaid product in your team. Only Production data is supported.

description.zh-CN: 搜索阅读收藏、划线和 Reader 文档。
description.en: Search saved reading, highlights and Reader documents.

description.zh-CN: 整理书签、收藏夹，找回保存过的网页。
description.en: Organize bookmarks and collections, and find saved pages.

note.zh-CN: 免费账户可有限使用；全文和语义搜索需要 Pro。
note.en: Free accounts have limited access. Full-text and semantic search require Pro.

description.zh-CN: 搜索 Pocket 录音、转录与会议摘要。
description.en: Search Pocket recordings, transcripts and meeting summaries.

note.zh-CN: 这是 Pocket AI 录音服务，需要已有账户和录音内容。
note.en: This is the Pocket AI recording service. An account and existing recordings are required.

description.zh-CN: 连接自己的智能家居，查询和控制已公开的设备。
description.en: Connect your smart home to query and control exposed devices.

note.zh-CN: 先在 Home Assistant 添加 MCP Server 集成并选择可访问的设备。填写自己实例的 HTTPS 地址，路径为 /api/mcp；本机回环地址也支持 HTTP。
note.en: Enable the MCP Server integration in Home Assistant and choose exposed devices. Enter your instance’s HTTPS URL ending in /api/mcp; HTTP is also supported for loopback addresses.

description.zh-CN: 搜索航班、比较行程并获取预订链接。
description.en: Search flights, compare itineraries and get booking links.

note.zh-CN: 搜索无需登录；预订需打开 Kiwi.com 链接完成。
note.en: No sign-in is needed for search. Complete bookings through the Kiwi.com link.

description.zh-CN: 通过本机 Fantastical 管理日历与日程。
description.en: Work with calendars and events through Fantastical on this Mac.

note.zh-CN: 需要在本机 Applications 文件夹安装 Fantastical 4.1.17 或更新版本。
note.en: Requires Fantastical 4.1.17 or later installed in this Mac’s Applications folder.

description.zh-CN: 搜索、回顾和记录本机 Day One 日记。
description.en: Search, review and write Day One journal entries on this Mac.

note.zh-CN: 需要 Day One Mac 2026.17+ 和 Silver/Gold 订阅。先在应用中安装 Command Line Tools，并在 Labs → MCP Access Control 中授权日记。
note.en: Requires Day One for Mac 2026.17+ and a Silver/Gold subscription. Install Command Line Tools from the app, then authorize journals in Labs → MCP Access Control.

description.zh-CN: 查地点、规划路线，获取天气和出行信息。
description.en: Find places, plan routes and check weather and travel information.

note.zh-CN: 需要在高德开放平台创建应用并申请 Web 服务 API Key。保存时会运行官方 MCP 包，Key 通过加密保存的环境变量传递。
note.en: Create an app and Web Service API key on Amap’s developer platform. Saving runs the official MCP package; the key is passed through an encrypted environment variable.

description.zh-CN: 了解官方运动数据与训练趋势连接器。
description.en: Explore the official activity data and training trends connector.

note.zh-CN: 官方当前仅支持 Claude 接入，并需要 Strava 订阅。Shoggoth 暂不能直接连接；此处提供官方接入说明。
note.en: The official connector currently supports Claude and requires a Strava subscription. Direct connection from Shoggoth is unavailable; see the official guide.

description.zh-CN: 查看预约、空闲时间和安排会议。
description.en: Review bookings, availability and meeting schedules.

note.zh-CN: 需要 Calendly 账户；可用操作取决于账户权限。
note.en: Requires a Calendly account. Available actions depend on account permissions.

description.zh-CN: 搜索和整理笔记与笔记本。
description.en: Search and organize notes and notebooks.

note.zh-CN: 需要付费套餐；官方 MCP 仍在 Beta 开放阶段。
note.en: Requires a paid plan. The official MCP is still rolling out in beta.

description.zh-CN: 查看客户资料、营销活动和分析数据。
description.en: Work with customer profiles, campaigns and marketing analytics.

note.zh-CN: 需要账户 Owner、Admin 或 Manager 权限。
note.en: Requires an Owner, Admin or Manager role.

description.zh-CN: 查询 Withings 设备和健康记录。
description.en: Query Withings devices and health records.

note.zh-CN: 需要 Withings 账户及相应会员资格，并授权可访问的数据。
note.en: Requires a Withings account, an eligible membership and permission to access your data.

description.zh-CN: 读取自己授权的健康记录。
description.en: Read health records you have authorized.

note.zh-CN: 需完成 HealthEx 身份与医疗机构授权；记录可用性取决于支持的机构，授权可能需要较长时间。
note.en: Complete HealthEx identity and provider consent. Available records depend on supported providers, and consent can take some time.

description.zh-CN: 创建、查看和管理 Replit 应用。
description.en: Create, inspect and manage Replit apps.

note.zh-CN: 使用自己的 Replit 账户授权；仅能访问账户有权限的项目。
note.en: Authorize with your Replit account. Only projects you can access are available.

description.zh-CN: 创建和管理 Lovable 项目与应用。
description.en: Create and manage Lovable projects and apps.

note.zh-CN: 桌面本机回调支持自动注册；企业管理员可能需要先允许 MCP。
note.en: Desktop loopback callbacks support automatic registration. Enterprise admins may need to enable MCP.

description.zh-CN: 通过已授权的应用执行自动化动作。
description.en: Run automation actions through connected apps.

note.zh-CN: 先在 Zapier 连接下游应用并选择动作；调用消耗 Zapier tasks。
note.en: Connect your apps and select actions in Zapier first. Calls consume Zapier tasks.

description.zh-CN: 搜索邮件并处理草稿。
description.en: Search mail and work with drafts.

note.zh-CN: 需要 Google Workspace 开发者预览资格、已启用对应 API 的 Cloud 项目，以及自己的 OAuth Client ID / Secret；请登记下方显示的回调地址。
note.en: Requires Google Workspace Developer Preview access, a Cloud project with the APIs enabled and your OAuth client credentials. Register the callback URL shown below.

description.zh-CN: 查看日历、空闲时间和事件。
description.en: Read calendars, availability and events.

note.zh-CN: 需要 Google Workspace 开发者预览资格、已启用对应 API 的 Cloud 项目，以及自己的 OAuth Client ID / Secret；请登记下方显示的回调地址。
note.en: Requires Google Workspace Developer Preview access, a Cloud project with the APIs enabled and your OAuth client credentials. Register the callback URL shown below.

description.zh-CN: 查询联系人与组织目录。
description.en: Look up contacts and directory entries.

note.zh-CN: 需要 Google Workspace 开发者预览资格、已启用对应 API 的 Cloud 项目，以及自己的 OAuth Client ID / Secret；请登记下方显示的回调地址。
note.en: Requires Google Workspace Developer Preview access, a Cloud project with the APIs enabled and your OAuth client credentials. Register the callback URL shown below.

description.zh-CN: 读取和编辑 Google 文档。
description.en: Read and edit Google documents.

note.zh-CN: 需要 Google Workspace 开发者预览资格、已启用对应 API 的 Cloud 项目，以及自己的 OAuth Client ID / Secret；请登记下方显示的回调地址。
note.en: Requires Google Workspace Developer Preview access, a Cloud project with the APIs enabled and your OAuth client credentials. Register the callback URL shown below.

description.zh-CN: 搜索和管理云端文件。
description.en: Search and manage cloud files.

note.zh-CN: 需要 Google Workspace 开发者预览资格、已启用对应 API 的 Cloud 项目，以及自己的 OAuth Client ID / Secret；请登记下方显示的回调地址。
note.en: Requires Google Workspace Developer Preview access, a Cloud project with the APIs enabled and your OAuth client credentials. Register the callback URL shown below.

description.zh-CN: 读取和编辑电子表格。
description.en: Read and edit spreadsheets.

note.zh-CN: 需要 Google Workspace 开发者预览资格、已启用对应 API 的 Cloud 项目，以及自己的 OAuth Client ID / Secret；请登记下方显示的回调地址。
note.en: Requires Google Workspace Developer Preview access, a Cloud project with the APIs enabled and your OAuth client credentials. Register the callback URL shown below.

description.zh-CN: 读取和编辑演示文稿。
description.en: Read and edit presentations.

note.zh-CN: 需要 Google Workspace 开发者预览资格、已启用对应 API 的 Cloud 项目，以及自己的 OAuth Client ID / Secret；请登记下方显示的回调地址。
note.en: Requires Google Workspace Developer Preview access, a Cloud project with the APIs enabled and your OAuth client credentials. Register the callback URL shown below.

description.zh-CN: 连接 Zoom 会议与协作工具。
description.en: Connect Zoom meetings and collaboration tools.

note.zh-CN: 先创建 Zoom General App，配置用户 OAuth 和所需权限，并登记下方回调地址。
note.en: Create a Zoom General App with user OAuth and the required scopes, then register the callback URL shown below.

description.zh-CN: 管理任务、项目和团队工作。
description.en: Manage tasks, projects and team work.

note.zh-CN: 使用 Asana v2 MCP；需要预先登记的 OAuth Client ID / Secret 和当前回调地址。
note.en: Uses Asana v2 MCP. Supply a registered OAuth client and register the current callback URL.

description.zh-CN: 搜索和处理 Box 文件与内容。
description.en: Search and work with Box files and content.

note.zh-CN: 请让 Box 管理员为 MCP 添加 Integration Credentials，并登记下方回调地址。
note.en: Ask a Box admin to create MCP Integration Credentials and register the callback URL shown below.

description.zh-CN: 搜索和管理 Dropbox 文件。
description.en: Search and manage Dropbox files.

note.zh-CN: Shoggoth 使用自备 Dropbox App 的 OAuth 凭据；请按官方指南配置权限和下方回调地址。
note.en: Use your own Dropbox App OAuth credentials. Configure its permissions and the callback URL below using the official guide.

description.zh-CN: 搜索、创建和编辑 Canva 设计。
description.en: Search, create and edit Canva designs.

note.zh-CN: 使用 Canva 账号登录并授权，无需手动填写 OAuth 应用凭据。团队账号可能需要管理员开启 AI Connector。
note.en: Sign in with your Canva account and authorize access; no manual OAuth app credentials are required. Team accounts may need an admin to enable AI Connector.

description.zh-CN: 管理联系人、商机和客户流程。
description.en: Manage contacts, opportunities and customer workflows.

note.zh-CN: 需要 HighLevel Private Integration Token 和 locationId；请从自己的子账户获取。
note.en: Requires a HighLevel Private Integration Token and locationId from your sub-account.

description.zh-CN: 查询车辆数据并使用已授权的车辆控制工具。
description.en: Query vehicle data and use authorized vehicle controls.

note.zh-CN: 在 Tessie Developer Settings 创建访问令牌；可用工具取决于令牌权限。
note.en: Create an access token in Tessie Developer Settings. Available tools depend on its permissions.

description.zh-CN: 搜索地点、查询天气和规划路线。
description.en: Search places, check weather and plan routes.

note.zh-CN: 使用已启用 Maps Grounding Lite 的 Google Maps API Key；用量与计费遵循 Google Cloud 项目设置。
note.en: Use a Google Maps API key with Maps Grounding Lite enabled. Usage and billing follow your Cloud project settings.

description.zh-CN: 搜索 Shopify 商品、比较商品并建立购物车。
description.en: Search Shopify products, compare items and build carts.

note.zh-CN: 商品搜索无需登录；此入口不提供完整商家后台管理。Shop Pay 和订单历史需要额外的 Shop 登录适配。
note.en: Product search needs no sign-in. This is not full merchant-admin access. Shop Pay and order history require additional Shop sign-in support.

description.zh-CN: 连接指定店铺的 UCP 结账工具。
description.en: Connect to a store's UCP checkout tools.

note.zh-CN: 填写店铺的 HTTPS 地址，路径为 /api/ucp/mcp，并提供 Catalog 访问令牌和买家 IP。令牌通常 60 分钟过期，需手动更新；工具调用需符合自己的 UCP 代理配置。
note.en: Enter the store's HTTPS URL ending in /api/ucp/mcp, a Catalog access token and buyer IP. Tokens normally expire after 60 minutes and must be updated manually. Tool calls must use your UCP agent profile.

description.zh-CN: 连接自己的 tailnet、SSH 与 Aperture 工具。
description.en: Connect your tailnet, SSH and Aperture tools.

note.zh-CN: 先配置 Aperture 与 grants，并连接对应 tailnet。填写自己的 HTTPS MCP 地址（/v1/mcp）；本机回环地址也支持 HTTP。
note.en: Configure Aperture and grants, then connect to its tailnet. Enter your HTTPS MCP URL ending in /v1/mcp; loopback HTTP is also supported.

description.zh-CN: 使用自己的 Link 钱包和已授权的财务数据。
description.en: Use your Link wallet and authorized financial data.

note.zh-CN: 需要 Node.js 24+；首次使用前按官方指南运行 Link CLI 登录。当前支持美国和加拿大 Link 账户。
note.en: Requires Node.js 24+. Sign in with the Link CLI using the official guide before first use. Currently supports US and Canadian Link accounts.

description.zh-CN: 查询和管理 QuickBooks Online 公司账务。
description.en: Query and manage QuickBooks Online company data.

note.zh-CN: 先下载并构建 Intuit 官方项目，完成 OAuth 授权。填写构建后 dist/index.js 的绝对路径（位于自己的用户目录），并提供凭据与可写的 Token 文件路径；不要填写未发布的 npm 包名。
note.en: Build Intuit's official project and complete OAuth first. Enter the absolute path to the built dist/index.js inside your user directory, plus credentials and a writable token-file path. The source package is not currently published to npm.

label.zh-CN: 可写 Token 文件（绝对路径）

description.zh-CN: 管理开发环境与环境变量挂载。
description.en: Manage developer environments and environment-variable mounts.

note.zh-CN: 在 1Password 桌面应用的 Developer 设置中开启 MCP 集成，并让 1password-mcp 可从 PATH 找到。需要时由桌面应用授权；此服务不返回密码或密钥值。
note.en: Enable MCP integration in the 1Password desktop Developer settings and make 1password-mcp available on PATH. Approvals happen in the desktop app. This service never returns password or secret values.

description.zh-CN: 查看 Microsoft 企业邮件 MCP 接入方式。
description.en: Review Microsoft enterprise mail MCP setup.

note.zh-CN: 需要 Agent 365 / Frontier 租户、Entra 应用和管理员授权；尚未提供适用于普通 Outlook 账户的通用接入配置。
note.en: Requires an Agent 365 / Frontier tenant, an Entra app and admin consent. A generic setup for personal Outlook accounts is not available.

description.zh-CN: 查看 Microsoft 企业日历 MCP 接入方式。
description.en: Review Microsoft enterprise calendar MCP setup.

note.zh-CN: 需要 Agent 365 / Frontier 租户、Entra 应用和管理员授权；尚未提供适用于普通 Outlook 账户的通用接入配置。
note.en: Requires an Agent 365 / Frontier tenant, an Entra app and admin consent. A generic setup for personal Outlook accounts is not available.

description.zh-CN: 查看官方部署和项目 MCP 的接入要求。
description.en: Review access requirements for Vercel's deployment and project MCP.

note.zh-CN: 官方远程 MCP 仅接受审核通过的客户端；Shoggoth 的客户端准入尚未确认。
note.en: The official remote MCP accepts approved clients only. Shoggoth client approval has not been confirmed.

description.zh-CN: 查看 Shop 登录与 Shop Pay 结账接入说明。
description.en: Review Shop sign-in and Shop Pay checkout setup.

note.zh-CN: Shop Pay 需要 Shop 登录；当前推荐可直接使用 Shopify 商品搜索，支付授权流程仍需单独适配。
note.en: Shop Pay requires Shop sign-in. Shopify product search is available separately; the payment authorization flow still needs integration.

description.zh-CN: 生成图像和视频，将创作结果保存到 Runway 素材库。
description.en: Generate images and videos and save results to your Runway library.

note.zh-CN: 使用 Runway 账号登录，无需 API Key。生成会消耗账号积分，可用模型取决于套餐；MCP 不支持 Explore Mode。
note.en: Sign in with your Runway account; no API key is needed. Generations use account credits and model access depends on your plan. Explore Mode is unavailable through MCP.

description.zh-CN: 生成和编辑图像、视频与音频，整理创作素材。
description.en: Generate and edit images, video and audio, and organize creative assets.

note.zh-CN: 使用 Higgsfield 账号登录，无需 API Key。需要有效的付费订阅；MCP 生成会消耗套餐积分，网页端的免费或 Unlimited 额度不适用。
note.en: Sign in with your Higgsfield account; no API key is needed. An active paid subscription is required. MCP generations use plan credits; web-only free and Unlimited allowances do not apply.

description.zh-CN: 通过官方 FLUX MCP 生成、编辑图像和视频，查看历史作品。
description.en: Generate and edit images and video, and browse past results with the official FLUX MCP.

note.zh-CN: 使用 BFL 账号登录并选择计费组织，无需 API Key。生成费用由所选组织承担；更换组织需要断开后重新登录。
note.en: Sign in with your BFL account and choose the billed organization; no API key is needed. Generations are billed to that organization. Reconnect to choose a different organization.

description.zh-CN: 查找生成模型与价格，生成图像、视频和音频并查询任务结果。
description.en: Find generative models and pricing, create images, video and audio, and retrieve job results.

note.zh-CN: 通过 fal 官方网页登录授权，无需填写 FAL_KEY。生成按模型用量计费，使用 fal 控制台中选定的 MCP 账号。
note.en: Authorize through fal's browser sign-in; no FAL_KEY is needed. Generations are billed by model usage to the active MCP account selected in your fal dashboard.

description.zh-CN: 连接 Blender 官方 Lab MCP，分析场景、编辑对象并操作 Blender Python API。
description.en: Connect the official Blender Lab MCP to inspect scenes, edit objects and use the Blender Python API.

setupSteps.zh-CN: 安装并打开 Blender 5.1 或更新版本，按官方指南安装 MCP 插件，并在插件设置中启动连接服务。
setupSteps.en: Install and open Blender 5.1 or newer, install the MCP add-on from the official guide, and start its bridge in the add-on preferences.

setupSteps.zh-CN: 从 projects.blender.org/lab/blender_mcp 安装官方 MCP 服务到当前用户目录下的 Python 虚拟环境。PyPI 上的同名 blender-mcp 属于另一个项目。
setupSteps.en: Install the official server from projects.blender.org/lab/blender_mcp into a Python virtual environment under your user directory. The similarly named blender-mcp on PyPI is a different project.

setupSteps.zh-CN: 在启动命令中填写该环境的 Python 绝对路径，例如 /Users/你的用户名/blender_mcp/mcp/.venv/bin/python。保留下方已填好的参数，保存后检查连接。
setupSteps.en: Enter the absolute path to that environment's Python executable, for example /Users/your-name/blender_mcp/mcp/.venv/bin/python. Keep the prefilled arguments, save, then check the connection.

note.zh-CN: 本机连接无需账号登录。使用场景工具时保持 Blender 与插件服务运行；MCP 可以执行 Python 并修改当前场景，请先保存工程副本。
note.en: This local connection needs no account sign-in. Keep Blender and its bridge running when using scene tools. MCP can execute Python and change the current scene; save a copy of your project first.

description.zh-CN: 通过小米官方 Home Assistant 集成连接米家设备。
description.en: Connect Xiaomi Home devices through Xiaomi’s official Home Assistant integration.

note.zh-CN: 需要已有 Home Assistant 实例。米家账号扫码在小米官方集成中完成；这里连接该实例，不提供独立米家云端扫码入口。填写实例的 /api/mcp 地址和长期访问令牌。
note.en: Requires an existing Home Assistant instance. Sign in to Xiaomi Home in Xiaomi’s official integration, then connect that instance here using its /api/mcp URL and a long-lived access token.

setupSteps.zh-CN: 在 Home Assistant 安装 Xiaomi/ha_xiaomi_home，并在官方页面扫码授权米家账号。
setupSteps.en: Install Xiaomi/ha_xiaomi_home in Home Assistant and authorize your Xiaomi account on its official sign-in page.

setupSteps.zh-CN: 在 Home Assistant 启用 Model Context Protocol Server，并选择允许助理访问的设备。
setupSteps.en: Enable Model Context Protocol Server in Home Assistant and select the devices agents may access.

setupSteps.zh-CN: 填写 HTTPS 实例地址，以 /api/mcp 结尾；本机回环可用 HTTP。在个人资料的安全设置创建长期访问令牌后粘贴到下方。
setupSteps.en: Enter your HTTPS instance URL ending in /api/mcp; loopback HTTP is supported. Create a long-lived access token in your profile’s Security settings and paste it below.

description.zh-CN: 查询出行方案、预估费用，并在确认后发起打车。
description.en: Explore ride options, estimate fares and request a ride after confirmation.

label.zh-CN: 滴滴 MCP 申请 Key

note.zh-CN: 先在滴滴 MCP 平台申请 Key。Key 会加密保存，只在连接官方服务时注入，不需要放进上面的地址。行程创建与取消会使用你的滴滴账号。
note.en: Apply for a key on DiDi’s MCP platform. It is stored encrypted and injected only when connecting to the official service; keep it out of the URL. Ride requests and cancellations use your DiDi account.

description.zh-CN: 查询美国境内 Uber 车型、预估车费与接驾时间，在 Uber App 完成叫车。
description.en: Compare Uber ride options, fare estimates and pickup times in the US. Complete bookings in the Uber app.

note.zh-CN: 官方目录标注查询无需登录。若服务拒绝连接（403），请向 Uber 确认当前客户端的接入条件。叫车与付款需在 Uber App 中完成。
note.en: The official directory lists searches as requiring no sign-in. If the service denies the connection (403), confirm client access requirements with Uber. Booking and payment take place in the Uber app.

description.zh-CN: 搜索美国境内的餐厅、菜单和菜品，在 Uber Eats App 完成下单与付款。
description.en: Search restaurants, menus and dishes in the US. Complete orders and payments in the Uber Eats app.

note.zh-CN: 官方目录标注搜索无需登录。若服务拒绝连接（403），请向 Uber 确认当前客户端的接入条件。此连接器仅用于浏览，购物车、下单与付款需在 Uber Eats App 中完成。
note.en: The official directory lists searches as requiring no sign-in. If the service denies the connection (403), confirm client access requirements with Uber. This connector supports browsing; finalize your cart, order and payment in the Uber Eats app.

description.zh-CN: 查找门店、浏览饮品与优惠，并在确认后下单。
description.en: Find stores, browse drinks and offers, and place orders after confirmation.

note.zh-CN: 在瑞幸官方开放页面登录并获取个人授权 Token，粘贴到访问令牌。连接检查不会下单；实际订单需按你的指令确认。
note.en: Sign in on Luckin’s official platform and paste your personal authorization token below. Connection checks do not place orders; ordering requires your instruction.

description.zh-CN: 查询麦当劳活动、优惠券、门店与餐品信息。
description.en: Explore McDonald’s promotions, coupons, stores and menu information.

note.zh-CN: 在麦当劳官方 MCP 页面登录并获取 Token。可用工具与活动资格由账号权限决定。
note.en: Sign in on McDonald’s official MCP page to obtain a token. Available tools and offer eligibility depend on your account.

description.zh-CN: 检查浏览器网络、控制台与页面性能，协助调试网站。
description.en: Inspect browser requests, console output and page performance to debug websites.

note.zh-CN: 需要本机 Chrome 和 Node.js。使用专用浏览器资料，登录一次后会保留登录状态并在重开时恢复；网站登录过期时需重新登录。
note.en: Requires local Chrome and Node.js. A dedicated browser profile keeps sign-ins and restores the session when reopened. Sign in again when a website's login expires.

description.zh-CN: 查询开发库与框架的最新文档和代码示例。
description.en: Find current library and framework documentation and code examples.

note.zh-CN: 可先匿名连接，额度较低。需要更多额度时，在下方访问令牌中填写 Context7 API Key。
note.en: Anonymous access has lower limits. For higher limits, enter your Context7 API key in the access-token field below.

description.zh-CN: 读取项目组件与文档，辅助编写 Stories 和测试。
description.en: Read project components and documentation to write stories and tests.

note.zh-CN: 先在自己的 Storybook 项目安装官方 @storybook/addon-mcp 并启动开发服务器，再填写项目的 MCP 地址。默认端口为 6006。
note.en: Install the official @storybook/addon-mcp in your Storybook project and start its dev server, then enter the project MCP address. The default port is 6006.

setupSteps.zh-CN: 在项目中安装 @storybook/addon-mcp，并加入 Storybook addons 配置。
setupSteps.en: Install @storybook/addon-mcp in your project and add it to the Storybook addons configuration.

setupSteps.zh-CN: 启动 Storybook；确认下面的地址与实际端口和 MCP 路径一致。
setupSteps.en: Start Storybook and ensure the address below uses its actual port and MCP path.

description.zh-CN: 在你指定的目录中读取、搜索和编辑文件。
description.en: Read, search and edit files inside a directory you choose.

note.zh-CN: MCP 官方参考服务器。必须填写允许访问的绝对目录；没有默认授权目录。修改目录后保存会重新连接，留空保留已有配置。
note.en: An official MCP reference server. Enter the absolute directory to allow; no directory is granted by default. Saving a new directory reconnects; leaving it blank preserves the existing configuration.

label.zh-CN: 允许访问的目录（绝对路径）

description.zh-CN: 抓取公开网页并提取适合阅读的内容。
description.en: Fetch public web pages and extract readable content.

note.zh-CN: MCP 官方参考服务器，无需账号。需要本机 uv；保存时以 uvx 运行固定版本 Python 包。
note.en: An official MCP reference server without an account requirement. Requires local uv; saving runs the pinned Python package with uvx.

description.zh-CN: 查询当前时间，换算日期与时区。
description.en: Look up current time and convert between time zones.

note.zh-CN: MCP 官方参考服务器，无需账号。需要本机 uv；默认使用本机时区。
note.en: An official MCP reference server without an account requirement. Requires local uv and uses the local time zone by default.

description.zh-CN: 查询 n8n 节点和模板，辅助构建与验证工作流。
description.en: Find n8n nodes and templates to build and validate workflows.

note.zh-CN: 社区维护的 MCP。节点文档和模板无需 n8n 账号；管理实际工作流时，需同时填写自己的实例地址和 API Key。工作流使用的第三方服务仍需各自授权。
note.en: A community-maintained MCP. Node documentation and templates need no n8n account. To manage workflows, supply both your instance URL and API key. Services used by workflows require their own authorization.

description.zh-CN: 查询航班动态、机场天气、机票及中转信息。
description.en: Look up flight status, airport weather, fares and transfer information.

note.zh-CN: 注册飞友 AI 开放平台并创建 API Key。填写一次即可接入航空数据与 Tripmatch（火车票及空铁联运）两项服务，实际可用范围和计费按账号权限提供。
note.en: Create an API key on the VariFlight AI platform. Enter it once to connect both aviation data and Tripmatch (train and air-rail transfers). Account permissions and metered pricing apply.

description.zh-CN: 研究美股两周走势、比较个股与板块，并查看加密市场分析。
description.en: Research two-week US stock calls, compare stocks and sectors, and explore crypto market analysis.

note.zh-CN: 公开研究无需登录或 API Key；免费版有使用额度，按 StockMap 当前套餐提供。个人自选股工具需另行授权 StockMap 账号。模型判断仅供研究参考。
note.en: Public research needs no sign-in or API key. Free usage is limited by StockMap's current plan. Personal watchlist tools require separate StockMap account authorization. Model calls are research, not investment advice.

description.zh-CN: 查询证券行情、财务数据与金融资讯。
description.en: Query securities data, financial statements and financial news.

note.zh-CN: 在妙想 MCP 官网登录，点击“查看 API Key”获取 MCP 密钥，填写原值，无需加 Bearer。Skills / API 页面的 Key 不一定适用于此 MCP 服务。额度和数据范围按账号权限提供。
note.en: Sign in to the official MX MCP site and select View API Key to get your MCP key. Enter the raw value without Bearer. A key from the Skills / API page may not work with this MCP service. Quota and data coverage depend on your account.

description.zh-CN: 查询股票、基金、宏观与公告等专业金融数据。
description.en: Query professional stock, fund, macroeconomic and announcement data.

note.zh-CN: 登录同花顺或 iFinD 账号，在个人中心获取 MCP 密钥。填写密钥原值，无需加 Bearer；额度与数据权限按套餐提供。
note.en: Sign in with a Tonghuashun or iFinD account and get an MCP key from your personal center. Enter the raw key without Bearer; quota and data access depend on your plan.

description.zh-CN: 将 Wind 金融数据与分析能力接入助理。
description.en: Connect Wind financial data and analysis tools to your assistant.

note.zh-CN:
1. 访问 https://market.windalice.com，使用手机号登录。
2. 登录后，前往个人中心获取您的专属密钥。
note.en:
1. Visit https://market.windalice.com and sign in with your phone number.
2. After signing in, go to your personal center to get your dedicated API key.

description.zh-CN: 查询火车余票、车次、中转与经停站。
description.en: Look up train availability, timetables, transfers and intermediate stops.

note.zh-CN: Joooook 维护的社区 MCP，无需账号或 Key。需要本机 Node.js，仅提供铁路信息查询；购票请在官方渠道完成。
note.en: A community MCP maintained by Joooook. Requires local Node.js, with no account or key needed. Provides rail information; complete bookings through official channels.

description.zh-CN: 搜索演唱会、赛事、艺人和场馆，查看图片、公开票价区间与官方活动链接。
description.en: Search concerts, events, artists and venues; get images, public price ranges and official event links.

setupSteps.zh-CN: 在 Ticketmaster 开发者后台的 My Apps 中，复制 Consumer Key，并填写到下方。
setupSteps.en: In Ticketmaster Developer Portal → My Apps, copy your Consumer Key into the field below.

setupSteps.zh-CN: 保存后自动检查连接，再选择哪些助理可以使用。查询程序随 App 提供，本机需有 Python 3.9 或更新版本。
setupSteps.en: Save to check the connection, then choose which agents can use it. The query program is bundled; Python 3.9 or newer is required on this computer.

note.zh-CN: 独立的本地查询连接器，使用官方公开 Discovery API。Key 加密保存在本机；每次检查连接使用 1 次查询。默认额度为每天 5000 次，实际按账号限制；仅提供查询，实际选座和购买请打开官方活动链接。
note.en: Independent local connector using the official public Discovery API. The key is encrypted locally. Each connection check uses one query. Default quota is 5,000 requests/day, subject to account limits. Queries only; use official event links to select seats and purchase.

description.zh-CN: 查询航班状态、位置与轨迹、时刻表、机场和航司动态，以及账号用量。
description.en: Look up flight status, positions, tracks, schedules, airport and airline activity, and account usage.

setupSteps.zh-CN: 已有 AeroAPI Key 时填写到下方。获取 Key 需在 FlightAware 官网单独开通 AeroAPI；此连接器不会替你订阅或付款。
setupSteps.en: Enter an existing AeroAPI key below. Obtaining one requires separate AeroAPI enrollment on FlightAware; this connector does not subscribe or pay for you.

setupSteps.zh-CN: 本机需要 Python 3.9 或更新版本。保存和检查只读取官方标价为 $0 的账号用量接口，不查询航班。
setupSteps.en: Python 3.9+ is required. Saving/checking reads only the documented $0 account-usage endpoint, not flight data.

setupSteps.zh-CN: 可能计费的查询默认关闭。以后确认账号已开通并接受按量费用后，再勾选允许查询并保存。
setupSteps.en: Metered queries are off by default. Enable and save them only after enrollment and acceptance of usage charges.

note.zh-CN: 独立本地连接器，使用官方 AeroAPI v4；Key 加密保存在本机。Personal 的 $5 月度额度不是费用硬上限；计费按账号和端点执行，不能保证免费。每次只取一页，不自动重试，不创建提醒或提交飞行计划。
note.en: Independent local connector using official AeroAPI v4. Keys are encrypted locally. The Personal $5 monthly credit is not a hard spending cap; charges depend on account and endpoint. Single-page reads, no automatic retries, alerts or flight-intent writes.
